diagnosis: Check C1 is leaking because it passes in every rollout despite the lone decision-maker only having access to the public offer ($10,000,000 at 92%) and not the revised terms in PF1 ($6,000,000 at 88%). The model is defaulting to the public offer's face amount and price instead of the required conditional purchase amount specified by PF1.

C1.why: The public offer supports buying the full $10,000,000 at 92%, while PF1 supplies the exact revised purchase terms of $6,000,000 at 88%; under shared policy S5, those stated maximums become the required conditional purchase rather than a reason to decline.
